title: FlixHUB TV v1.1.1 — 4K Aliases, External USB & Offline Library
releaseNotes: Server aliases enabled across app (GOKU, VEGITA, BULMA, ZENO, SUPREME, BERUS) with zero open provider names
External USB drive & removable TV storage support with self-contained independent offline media folders
Frosted glass Download Quality selector with 4K multi-audio variants, device storage check, and Pause/Resume/Cancel
Redesigned Apple TV Library with spotlight banner, Continue Watching, and Offline Series Episode Thumbnails
Live offline connectivity detection with bottom toast and automatic redirect to Saved Downloads
